versions under test.

put.description:
Update the project-version on status, issues and bugs.

**started** and **end_forecast** are dates in YYY-mm-dd format.

**status** is one of:

   - recorded
   - campaign started
   - campaign ended
   - test plan writing
   - test plan sent
   - test plan accepted
   - ter writing
   - ter sent
   - cancelled
   - archived

Only admin or user can update a version

get.description:
Retrieve all users with their scopes.

With the `is_list=true` retrieve only the usernames.

By default, gather all users (everyone is in the special project `*`).

Using a project name and `included=false`, retrieve all users not in this specific project.
Application administrator are excluded.

BaseScenario.title: BaseScenario
BaseScenario.description:
Attributes:
    scenario_id: str
    epic: str
    feature_name: str
    filename: Optional str defaulted to None

CampaignFull.title: CampaignFull
CampaignFull.description:
Attributes
    - project_name: str
    - version: str
    - occurrence: int
    - description: Optional[str]
    - status: CampaignStatusEnum
    - tickets: Optional[list[TicketScenario | Ticket]] = []

CampaignLight.title: CampaignLight
CampaignLight.description:
Attributes
    - project_name: str
    - version: str
    - occurrence: int
    - description: Optional[str]
    - status: CampaignStatusEnum

CampaignProjection.title: CampaignProjection
CampaignProjection.description:
Projection for a project on Campaign for a version
Attributes
    - version: str
    - occurrences: List[int]
    - status: StatusEnum

CampaignProjections.title: CampaignProjections
CampaignProjections.description:
Container of projections
Attributes:
    - count: int the total count of versions with campaign
    - data: list of CampaignProjection

Feature-Input.title: Feature
Feature-Input.description:
Attributes:
    name (name | feature_name): str
    tags: str = ""
    filename: str = None
    description: str = ""
    epic_name (epic |epic_name) = ""
    project_name: str = ""
    scenarios: Scenarios |None= None
    scenario_ids: list[str|int] |str = []

Feature-Output.title: Feature
Feature-Output.description:
Attributes:
    name (name | feature_name): str
    tags: str = ""
    filename: str = None
    description: str = ""
    epic_name (epic |epic_name) = ""
    project_name: str = ""
    scenarios: Scenarios |None= None
    scenario_ids: list[str|int] |str = []

OccurrenceStatus.title: OccurrenceStatus
OccurrenceStatus.description:
Simple object linking occurrence and status
Attributes
    - occurrence: int
    - status: CampaignStatusEnum

ProjectProjections.title: ProjectProjections
ProjectProjections.description: The enum for the various projections

ScenarioExecution.title: ScenarioExecution
ScenarioExecution.description:
Attributes:
    scenario_id: str
    epic: str
    feature_name: str
    filename: Optional str defaulted to None
    name: str
    steps: str
    status: ScenarioStatusEnum | TestResultStatusEnum
    scenario_tech_id: Optional int defaulted as None

Ticket.title: Ticket
Ticket.description:
Attributes:
    status
    reference
    description
    created
    updated

TicketScenario.title: TicketScenario
TicketScenario.description:
Attributes
    - reference: str
    - summary: str
    - status: Optional[TicketType] = TicketType.OPEN
    - scenarios: Optional[list[ScenarioExecution]] = []

TicketScenarioCampaign.title: TicketScenarioCampaign
TicketScenarioCampaign.description:
Attributes
    - ticket_reference: str
    - scenarios: Optional[Union[ScenarioCampaign, List[ScenarioCampaign]]]
